description:
Saves the notification settings; send only what changes. Fields set by environment variables are ignored. public_url is stored without a trailing slash. The public URL is the address of the links in mails (password reset links among them), so a session is required.

Needs: a signed-in session (API tokens are refused). Administrators only

public_url.description: The https address of this instance (https://host, no path), empty to clear

default_language.description: The language of mails to people without a language of their own. Default: en

alerts_admins.description: Mail alerts go to every enabled administrator with a valid address

alerts_addresses.description: Extra addresses that get alert mails: at most 20, one plain address each (a bad one is refused naming its index and the address in message_values). Ignored while ALERT_ADDRESSES is set

alerts_events.description: The events mailed as alerts. Only the state events and webhook.disabled are accepted (error.notify-event-not-for-mail otherwise, also for *); see GET /notifications/events

reminder_hours.description: Hours between reminders of a state that is still bad, 0 for none

200.description: The notification settings as they are now
